translations.web: “ ‘Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: “Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
translations.bsb: Yes, this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the city of bloodshed! I, too, will pile the kindling high.
translations.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the bloody city! I will even make the pile for fire great.
translations.asv: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Woe to the bloody city! I also will make the pile great.
